           GENTIANA LUTEA

         Yellow Gentian


Stomach symptoms marked. Acts as a tonic, increasing appetite.



Head.--  Vertigo, worse, rising or motion; better open air.
        Frontal headache, better eating and open air. Brain feels loose, head tender. Aching in
        eyes.



Throat.--  Dry. Thick saliva.



Stomach.--  Acid risings, ravenous hunger, nausea, weight and
        aching in stomach. Inflation and tension of stomach and abdomen (  Pothos  ).
        Colic, umbilical region sensitive to touch. Flatulence.



Relationship.--  Compare:   Gentiana
        quinque flora   (intermittent fever; dyspepsia, cholera infantum, weakness);   Gentiana cruciata   (throat symptoms in addition to similar
        stomach symptoms; dysphagia; vertigo with headache; pressing inward sensation in eyes;
        constricted throat and head and abdomen. Distention, fullness and tightness in abdomen.
        Creeping over body as from fleas).   Hydrast; Nux  .



Dose.--  First to third attenuation.
